'''Kinkosa City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] in the state of [[Kinkosa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtania]]. The [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Schnil Hakoon/Legends|Schnil Hakoon]] had his [[Schnil Hakoon's headquarters|center of power]] in this city. [[Kinkosa Starport]] was located within its boundaries, and there was a heavy [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence due to an [[Imperial work camp]] in the nearby [[Kinkosa rain forest|rain forest]].
